## Purpose
Prettier style for the frontend.

## Settings that matter
`printWidth: 100`, `semi: true`, `singleQuote: false`, `trailingComma: "all"`.

## Read by
Prettier, and ESLint through `eslint-plugin-prettier`.

## Environment-specific differences
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
Lint fails on formatting differences, because Prettier runs as an ESLint rule.

## How to rebuild this file
The JSON above.
